current.text: Meleek Thomas is a 20-year-old rookie guard. Cleveland took him with the 34th pick in the 2026 draft, in the second round, after trading back from 29.
He was the top-ranked fantasy player of summer league. He averaged 26 points, 4 assists and 2 steals and shot 50% from the field and 44% from three.

Cleveland's projected starters are James Harden, Donovan Mitchell, Peyton Watson, Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen. The projected bench is Tyson, Merrill, Bryant, Tomlin and Porter. Thomas is in neither group.
Experts see no immediate role for him behind James Harden and Donovan Mitchell. It is unclear how he fits at first.

Experts rate him well above his draft slot and above consensus. He is called one of the biggest risers versus his draft slot. One expert would rank him around 14 to 16 among rookies on a team with a clearer role.
One expert expects him to be a 27-minute third guard within two years. Another calls him a long-term hold because the futures of Harden and Mitchell in Cleveland are uncertain.
He has a high ceiling, but his body needs work.

durable.text: He is a guard from Arkansas with good size. At Arkansas he shot 42% from three, made his twos at a good rate and had a good free throw percentage.
One expert thinks his college numbers were held down by playing next to high-usage Darius Acuff. He also thinks Thomas can pass more and defend solidly.
Experts expect him to become a starting-caliber NBA player.

tags.name: minutes competition
tags.detail: Blocked by James Harden and Donovan Mitchell in the backcourt. He is not in the projected starting group or the projected bench.

note: Thomas is not an auction target for us. Yahoo ranks him 618th with a value of 0 USD, ESPN does not rank him, and his Yahoo projection is only 5.6 points in a part-time role. Experts like his shooting and his summer league line, but they see no role for him this season behind Harden and Mitchell. Check his minutes early in the season and if a Cleveland guard gets hurt. Until his role grows, he does not need a roster spot in a 12-team league.
